fields.label: Analytics Region
fields.help: Primary GCP region for analytics data storage.

fields.label: API Consumer Data Encryption Key Name
fields.help: Cloud KMS key name used for encrypting API consumer data.

fields.label: API Consumer Data Location
fields.help: This field is needed only for customers using non-default data residency regions.

fields.label: Authorized Network
fields.help: Compute Engine network used for Service Networking to be peered with Apigee runtime instances.

fields.label: Billing Type
fields.help: Billing type of the Apigee organization.

fields.label: Control Plane Encryption Key Name
fields.help: Cloud KMS key name used for encrypting control plane data that is stored in a multi region.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Disable VPC Peering
fields.help: Flag that specifies whether the VPC Peering through Private Google Access should be disabled between the consumer network and Apigee.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The display name of the Apigee organization.

fields.label: Project ID
fields.help: The project ID associated with the Apigee organization.

fields.label: Runtime Database Encryption Key Name
fields.help: Cloud KMS key name used for encrypting the data that is stored and replicated across runtime instances.

fields.label: Runtime Type
fields.help: Runtime type of the Apigee organization based on the Apigee subscription purchased.
